title: Brand-checked-timers pin never invokes the wrapped clear — a detached-clearTimeout regression ships green
location: scripts/js-tests/form_draft_wiring.test.js (test 'debounce survives brand-checked host timers (Perkins r2 B1)')
detail: The new round-3 regression test fires step-changed exactly once, so trigger() runs with id === null and t.clear is never called; cancel() is also never reached (no pagehide). The brand-checked fake env.clearTimeout is therefore never exercised: reverting only the clear wrapper to a detached ref (Illegal invocation on the next rapid step-change in real browsers) passes the whole suite. The r2 B1 fix wrapped BOTH timers; the pin covers only set.
recommended_fix: In the brand-check test, fire EVENT_STEP_CHANGED twice in quick succession (or invoke the pagehide listener) so the wrapped clear path executes against the brand-checked fake before asserting.

title: Spec task schema literal for application_draft omits erased_at that the migration in the same diff creates
evidence:
+- [x] `supabase/migrations/<ts>_create_application_draft.sql` — `application_draft(id uuid PK DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), vacancy_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES vacancy(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, email text NOT NULL, fields jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', continue_token text NULL, last_link_sent_at timestamptz NULL, resumed_at timestamptz NULL, submitted_at timestamptz NULL, created_at/updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), UNIQUE(vacancy_id, email))`
vs migration:
+  erased_at          TIMESTAMPTZ,
detail: The checked-off task line enumerates every column but lacks erased_at; the migration adds it (W3 tombstone, documented only in the later change log). The task list is outside the frozen block, so the schema of record in the spec contradicts the shipped DDL within one diff.
recommended_fix: Add `erased_at timestamptz NULL` to the task-line column list (one-line edit), matching the migration and the W3 change-log entry.

title: Spec claims the serializer skips hidden inputs; shouldSkipControl has no hidden-type arm
detail: The spec's skip-list names 'hidden', but the predicate skips only file/submit/button/fieldset types plus _-prefixed and gdpr_consent names — a hidden input without a _-prefixed name would serialize into the draft. Either the spec overclaims or the serializer under-filters; the known internals (_website, _form_loaded_at) happen to be covered by the name rule.
recommended_fix: Add `if (type === "hidden") return true;` to shouldSkipControl (plus a unit pin), or drop 'hidden' from the spec's skip-list if the _-prefix convention is the intended coverage.
